about: Who owns the overlap when two different airports' Class D areas overlap. The NASR shapefile doesn't say; the answer is in each area's legal description in FAA Order JO 7400.11 (paragraph 5000). 'airspace' is the IDENT whose description excludes the other, so 'excludes' wins the overlap. Rules with "verified": false are inferred, not read from the legal text, and the build warns about them until someone checks.

classDExclusions.source: Mountain View (Moffett) Class D, surface up to but not including 2,500 MSL: '...excluding the portion within the Palo Alto of Santa Clara County Airport, CA, Class D airspace area during the specific dates and times it is effective.' Federal Register, 1998-05-05, doc 98-11856: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-1998-05-05/html/98-11856.htm
classDExclusions.note: Only Palo Alto's Class D volume is excluded, so Moffett's Class D continues above Palo Alto's 1,500/2,000 ft ceilings up to 2,500. When the Palo Alto tower is closed its Class D isn't in effect, so Moffett's covers that area from the surface.

classDExclusions.source: Eglin AFB Class D, surface to 2,600 MSL: 'When the tower at Destin Executive Airport is operational, it excludes Destin's Class D airspace ... from the surface to and including 1,600 feet MSL.' Federal Register, 2016-06-21, doc 2016-14377: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2016-06-21/html/2016-14377.htm
classDExclusions.note: Same pattern as Moffett and Palo Alto: Eglin's Class D continues above Destin's 1,600 ft ceiling.

classDExclusions.source: Boca Raton Class D: '...excluding that airspace within the Pompano Beach, Class D airspace area.' Federal Register, 2000-08-21, doc 00-21129 (correction): https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-08-21/html/00-21129.htm

Grand Prairie Class D: '...excluding the portion west of a line between lat. 32°45'00" N., long. 97°05'28" W., and lat. 32°38'10" N., long. 97°03'26" W.' Federal Register, 2009-09-08, doc E9-21269: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2009-09-08/html/E9-21269.htm
classDExclusions.note: The dividing line puts the Arlington side outside Grand Prairie. The overlap in the shapefile is a 0.4 km² sliver along that line.

classDExclusions.source: San Diego TAC, note by Imperial Beach NOLF: 'Class D excludes portion east of 117°01'W when BROWN Class D is in effect.'
classDExclusions.note: The chart divides them along 117°01'W, but Brown Field's edge is about 80 m west of that line, so the thin sliver between them goes to Brown Field here. Same simplification as Grand Prairie and Arlington.

classDExclusions.source: Not found online. Inferred: in every verified case where ceilings differ, the airport with the lower ceiling owns the overlap (Waldron 1,200 vs Corpus Christi NAS 2,500). Check the Corpus Christi NAS and Waldron descriptions in FAA Order JO 7400.11.
